Two years of In Balance

On August 30th, we're returning to KREUZWERK for a daytime open air to celebrate our second anniversary.

Over the past two years, In Balance has grown into something we could never have built on our own. Each dance brings us closer together, every connecting and joyful moment has shaped this project into what it is today. We're incredibly grateful for everyone who has been part of this journey.

As we believe our community can create a positive impact beyond the dancefloor, we'll donate €1 from every ticket sold to:
•⁠ ⁠Netzwerk Polylux e.V. 
•⁠ ⁠PRÜF
•⁠ ⁠ROSA e.V. Rolling Safespace
The total amount will be split evenly between all three organizations. We're looking forward to making this happen together.

We don’t tolerate any form of discrimination.
Minimum age: 21+

See you in the sun.
